review_method: Every original PNG page 1–10 was individually opened through view_image. No contact sheet, no alternative renderer, no reuse of previous-document approval.

pages.observations: Title, abstract, keywords and introduction readable. No missing glyphs, line clipping, overlap or collision with page number.
Introduction continuation, methods heading and 2.1 paragraph are complete. Lower whitespace keeps full Figure 1 on page 3. No cropped line or heading orphan.
Full Figure 1 panels a–d and complete caption fit on the page. Small English labels are readable and do not collide with panel edges. Caption and following paragraphs are separate; page number clear.
Sections 2.2/2.3 and displayed equations (1)/(2) render fully. Radical bar, sum limits, subscripts, Greek symbols and equation numbers are legible. No overlap with explanatory paragraphs.
Encoding/training text and equations (3)/(4) fit width and height. Inline superscripts and training parameters visible. No clipped formula or body/footer collision.
Sections 2.5/2.6 with all-chain split and comparator methods remain complete and readable. No missing unit glyphs or clipped lower paragraph.
Section 2.7, KIX/CBP protocol and KRAS sequences/replicates remain readable. Paragraph continuation at page break is normal. No equation or text overflow.
KRAS SEM continuation, ubiquitin methods and new figure callouts 3f and 5d/e/f are legible. Section 2.8 and equation (5) render fully with sums and log terms. Last line remains above footer.
Free-energy/entropy methods continuation, results heading and 3.1 opening fit. No glyph loss or clipping. Lower whitespace is intentional to keep Table 1 intact on page 10.

Table 1 grouped header, all rows in A/B sections, native three horizontal rules and full table note are visible. Numeric columns align. Following results paragraphs, updated Figure 2e/f callout and page number do not overlap; no split or cropped table row.
